Problem: LCD Reset bug disables Ethernet
Context: repo=stm32h743i-eval-bsp, mcu_series=H7, board=STM32H743I, component=ETH, layer=Other, issue_kind=bug_report, severity=medium, evidence_strength=high, rescue_applied=False, state=closed, issue_number=4
Root cause: ST Internal Reference: 176453 Fixed in : https://github.
Fix: STM32H743i_eval_lcd.
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: H7, STM32H743I, ETH, bug_report, medium, bug, bsp, internal bug tracker, LCD, PA2, RMII, MDIO

Technical details:
STM32H743i_eval_lcd.c V3.3.1 The eval board does not have a reset line for the LCD device and if the reset function at line 242 is called it will try to use initialize and use PA2 as the reset line which is used by the RMII ethernet for MDIO. This will prevent the ethernet phy from working correctly. At the very least this line should be commented out. Better still would be to remove the line and all code associated with initializing PA2 for use by the LCD which is found between lines 399 and 417. It would also be good to remove all associated lines in the .h file for the defines used by the code so no one will question the relevance of an LCD reset.

Key comments:
ST Internal Reference: 176453 Fixed in : https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32h743i-eval-bsp/commit/5ae5d39c0dbb87c49a3d3a59b54bbd4ac84e1873

Problem: Wrong core
Context: repo=stm32h743i-eval-bsp, mcu_series=H7, board=None, component=FREERTOS, layer=Middleware, issue_kind=usage_question, severity=medium, evidence_strength=medium, rescue_applied=False, state=closed, issue_number=3
Root cause: Hello @carlo-dev-git , There are two options for running FreeRTOS on ARM Cortex-M7 microcontrollers.
Fix: FreeRTOS examples are using the CM4F port.
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: H7, Middleware, FREERTOS, usage_question, medium, question, CM4F, Third_Party, RVDS, ARM_CM4F, CM7, ARM_CM7

Technical details:
FreeRTOS examples are using the CM4F port. <..>/Middlewares/Third_Party/FreeRTOS/Source/portable/RVDS/ARM_CM4F/port.c Why don't they use the CM7 port? <..>/Middlewares/Third_Party/FreeRTOS/Source/portable/RVDS/ARM_CM7/r0p1/port.c

Key comments:
Hello @carlo-dev-git , There are two options for running FreeRTOS on ARM Cortex-M7 microcontrollers. The best option depends on the revision of the ARM Cortex-M7 core in use. If the revision of the ARM Cortex-M7 core is not r0p1 then either option can be used, but it is recommended to use the FreeRTOS ARM Cortex-M4F port located in the /FreeRTOS/Source/portable/IAR/ARM_CM4F directory. If the revision of the ARM Cortex-M7 core is r0p1 then use the FreeRTOS ARM Cortex-M7 r0p1 port located in the /FreeRTOS/Source/portable/IAR/ARM_CM7/r0p1 directory. Hello @carlo-dev-git , Thank you for this contribution. Please allow me to close this thread as answered. You may reopen it at anytime if you have any details to share with us in order to help you to solve the issue. Thank you for your comprehension.
